mapper.select: SELECT user_id as userId, vlog_id as vlogId, MAX(score) as score FROM ( SELECT user_id, vlog_id, 1.0 as score FROM my_liked_vlog UNION ALL SELECT comment_user_id as user_id, vlog_id, 2.0 as score FROM comment WHERE (is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL) ) t GROUP BY user_id, vlog_id

SELECT user_id as userId, vlog_id as vlogId, MAX(score) as score FROM ( SELECT user_id, vlog_id, 1.0 as score FROM my_liked_vlog WHERE user_id = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT comment_user_id as user_id, vlog_id, 2.0 as score FROM comment WHERE comment_user_id = #{userId} AND (is_deleted = 0 OR is_deleted IS NULL) ) t GROUP BY user_id, vlog_id
